Subject: Re: Hosting options & compliance requirements — MedAlign discovery

Thanks Tom & Sarah — great conversation earlier. Short recap and proposed next steps from our side so we stay aligned on the compliance constraints that drive hosting choice.

Key points from the call:
- Data type: PHI in new pilot (patient identifiers + clinical notes).
- Primary must-haves: BAA in place, SOC2 Type II evidence, audit-ready request logs, support for VPC peering and private connectivity.
- Preferred deployment modes discussed: Hosted API for initial sandbox, Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput, Private (VPC/on-prem) for production PHI.

Immediate asks we heard from MedAlign:
1) Template BAA to start legal review.
2) SOC2 Type II report + scope and pen-test summary.
3) Evidence of audit log retention and export capability (for HIPAA audits).
4) Network diagrams / requirements for Private deployment evaluation.

Proposed next steps (Redwood):
- I will share a draft BAA and our latest SOC2 package by end of day tomorrow. (see attachments).
- Monica will scope a mutual action plan (MAP) covering a Private PoC timeline and Dedicated trial options.
- Aditya will coordinate the security questionnaire answers and any infrastructure diagrams you need.

Can you confirm the internal stakeholders who need to be on the MAP (legal, infosec, cloud ops)? Also share any internal timeline constraints — do you need production before year-end or is H1 2027 acceptable?

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Hosting options & compliance requirements — MedAlign discovery

Thanks Dylan — this is helpful. Quick clarifications from our side: 
- Confirming PHI scope: pilot includes full patient names, MRNs, and clinical notes; any solution handling production PHI will need a signed BAA and role-based access controls.
- SOC2: we need the Type II report covering security and availability for 2025 plus scope (in-scope systems). Pen test summary or statement of recent tests helpful.
- Audit/logging: retention of 7 years preferred for audit evidence; if not feasible, we need an export process for eDiscovery requests and demonstrable timestamps.
- Network: for Private deployment we require support for VPC peering with AWS accounts and/or a colocation-ready on-prem installer (air-gapped acceptable for the long-term roadmap).

Attached: our internal security questionnaire you mentioned — we filled what we could on discovery; please complete the answers on your side (see attached).

Also, timeline: target decision window is 8–10 weeks; ideal go-live for production PHI is Q1 2027 but flexibility exists if compliance gating items are longer.

Regards,
Tom Reynolds
Director, Product Security | MedAlign Health
T: 617-555-0199

Subject: Re: Hosting options & compliance requirements — MedAlign discovery (internal MAP draft)

Adding a short MAP draft to get ahead of the timelines Tom noted. I recommend we offer a two-track plan:

Track A — Rapid evaluation (non-PHI sandbox):
- Timeline: 2 weeks to spin up hosted sandbox for functional validation.
- Deliverables: API keys, sandbox dataset guidance, usage dashboard access.

Track B — Compliance-led production (PHI):
- Phase 1: Legal review & BAA signing (Redwood provides draft).
- Phase 2: Security evidence handoff (SOC2 Type II, pen test summary, questionnaire answers).
- Phase 3: Dedicated capacity trial (30–60 days) while we prepare Private VPC design if required.
- Phase 4: Private PoC or on-prem pilot (network validation + installation window: 4–6 weeks depending on infra readiness).

Owners:
- Legal/Contracts (Redwood Legal / MedAlign Legal) — BAA & MSA finalization
- Security (Aditya) — complete questionnaire, provide SOC2/pen test artifacts, arrange technical Q/A session
- Solutions/CS (Monica) — Dedicated trial setup, MAP coordination, runbook for PoC
- AE (Dylan) — commercial terms, deal milestones, HubSpot updates (RDW-DEAL-7891)

I attached a short MAP file and a checklist of artifacts to collect. I'll schedule a 30-minute internal sync for Redwood next week to align owners.

Monica Patel
Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

3) Questionnaire — Aditya will fill remaining details and provide pen-test summary by early next week.
